activation: native typed spawn_agent with exactly one wait_agent per fresh staged home
codex_version_policy: no exact release pin; record the observed parseable version and diagnose incompatibility per run

availability.gate: minimum 30 admitted stages and Wilson lower bound >= 0.90

stability.gate: fresh-home repeat integrity with no drift, orphan, cleanup, or inconclusive failure

aggregate.promotion: dispatch availability proven at confidence-adjusted score 9; content-bearing role fitness and high-reasoning switching remain separate claims
